label_provenance: Agent-authored against the current synthetic case studies; positive labels are not exhaustive. Unjudged documents count as nonrelevant.
warmup: No explicit warmup; sequential local calls include model loading where incurred
selection: Pending the user's decision; V0 remains the development baseline

calibration.limitation: Same local model for generation and judging; shared bias remains possible

ablation.delta_direction: Full V3 minus ablated configuration; positive means the removed component helped
ablation.selection: Candidate V3 ablation only; production selection remains with the user
ablation.timing_protocol: Fresh context per query/configuration, no explicit warmup, configuration order rotated by query; model loading is included

fixture_note: One RAG benchmark with labelled retrieval queries, controlled claim regressions, and fixed GigSim jobs; historical fixture populations differ.
